title: Time to Reason: Scalable Neurosymbolic Learning for LTLf via Fuzzy Semantics
abstract: arXiv:2608.16443v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neurosymbolic (NeSy) Artificial Intelligence aims to integrate Deep Learning (DL) architectures with symbolic reasoning. While initial NeSy approaches have targeted mainly symbolic reasoning in propositional and first-order logics, recent works have started to address the construction of neurosymbolic frameworks for Temporal Logics, and in particular for LTLf. These approaches have established temporal NeSy as a promising research direction, laying the foundations for learning under temporal constraints. Nonetheless, they leave many questions unanswered. From a theoretical perspective, several differentiable semantics for interpreting LTLf have been proposed but have not yet been formally and systematically defined within a unified framework. translated_title: 推理时刻：基于模糊语义的可扩展神经符号LTLf学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16443v1 公告类型：新 摘要：神经符号（NeSy）人工智能旨在将深度学习（DL）架构与符号推理相结合。虽然早期的NeSy方法主要针对命题逻辑和一阶逻辑中的符号推理，但最近的研究已开始着手构建时序逻辑，特别是LTLf的神经符号框架。这些方法将时序NeSy确立为一个有前景的研究方向，为在时序约束下的学习奠定了基础。尽管如此，它们仍留下了许多未解问题。从理论角度来看，已有多种用于解释LTLf的可微语义被提出，但尚未在统一框架内进行正式和系统的定义。此外，现有方法通常依赖自动机来表示时序知识，导致可扩展性有限。鉴于这一研究空白，本文做出了以下贡献。
tldr: 本文通过模糊语义提出了一种可扩展的神经符号LTLf学习方法，统一了可微语义框架并克服了基于自动机方法的扩展性瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a scalable neurosymbolic learning method for LTLf via fuzzy semantics, unifying differentiable semantic frameworks and overcoming scalability bottlenecks of automaton-based approaches.
